description: Ad-tech supply-chain + delivery-infrastructure + fraud-network observatory. Datafies the programmatic advertising ecosystem from the PUBLIC IAB web-standard files (ads.txt / app-ads.txt / sellers.json): the ad-tech entities (DSP / ad-exchange / SSP / ad-network / publisher / verification), the first-class AUTHORIZATION edges + the two-sided handshake whose GAPS reveal spoofed / unauthorized inventory, the creatives (who broadcasts what), the DELIVERY edges binding a creative to its serving in...
